The '''TF-6 Striker''' was a [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] model used during the [[Third Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="LotS" />

{{Veh-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The TF-6 Striker first appeared in Game Update 7.7.1 "Flashpoint Resurgence," released on [[August 19]], [[2025]], as part of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'',<ref name="LotS" /> the eighth digital expansion to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Announcement">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20210701|text=Announcing Legacy of the Sith, the next expansion for Star Wars: The Old Republic}}</ref> Players could obtain the TF-6 Striker mount through [[Wikipedia:Twitch (service)|Twitch]] Drops<ref name="Recap">{{TORweb|url=info/news/%5Bnews-category%5D/20250730|text=Game Update 7.7.1 Livestream Recap}}</ref>&mdash;a feature that allows viewers to earn in-game rewards by watching streams<ref name="Twitch">{{WebCite|url=https://help.twitch.tv/s/article/mission-based-drops?language=en_US|text=How to Earn Drops|archivedate=20240905214754|suppress=1}}</ref>&mdash;by watching any ''The Old Republic'' streams for four hours between [[August]] 19 and [[September 15]], 2025.<ref name="Recap" />
